;Arts and culture
**The [[Eurovision Song Contest 2020]], which is due to be held in the [[Netherlands]], is cancelled for the first time on the event's 64-year history due to the spread of [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/tv-and-radio/2020/mar/18/eurovision-song-contest-cancelled-due-to-coronavirus-pandemic (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on religion]]
**The Greek Orthodox [[Ecumenical Patriarchate of Constantinople]] issues a worldwide suspension of all "divine services, events, and rites, with the exception of private prayer in churches that will remain open, until the end of March". [https://www.ecupatria.org/2020/03/18/new-communique-concerning-the-covid-19-coronavirus/ (Ecupatria)]

;Business and economy
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**List of events affected by the COVID-19 pandemic, [[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
***The 2020 [[Glastonbury Festival]], scheduled for June 24–28, is cancelled due to the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/entertainment-arts-51942898 (BBC News)]
**[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] suspends all [[foreclosure|foreclosures]] and [[eviction|evictions]], and invokes the [[Defense Production Act]] to address shortages of supplies needed for responding to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|coronavirus outbreak]] in the country. [https://www.npr.org/2020/03/18/818069722/trump-invokes-a-cold-war-relic-the-defense-production-act-for-coronavirus-shorta (NPR)] [https://ktiv.com/2020/03/18/watch-live-white-house-coronavirus-task-force-holds-briefing/ (KTIV)]
***The [[United States Treasury Department|U.S. Treasury Department]] says it will ask [[United States Congress|Congress]] for $500 billion in direct payouts for taxpayers in order to combat the economic effects of the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]]. Under the current proposal, the payouts will consist of two tiered payments, with the amounts of each based on income level and family size. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/congress/americans-would-get-two-checks-under-treasury-department-proposal-n1163016 (NBC News)]
***Unemployment in the [[United States]] could reach 20 percent if sufficient action is not taken in responding to the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]], [[United States Secretary of the Treasury|Treasury Secretary]] [[Steven Mnuchin]] warns. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2020/mar/18/steven-mnuchin-coronavirus-unemployment-treasury-secretary (''The Guardian'')]
***The [[United States Senate|U.S. Senate]] approves the [[Families First Coronavirus Response Act]], an emergency relief aid bill, in response to the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]]. The bill will ensure that people who are employed in places with less than 500 employees will receive paid benefits while on leave. It also offers free testing for uninsured people and expands federal funding for medical coverage. [https://www.essence.com/articles/emergency-aid-relief-bill-covid-19/ (''Essence'')]
***President Trump signs the [[Families First Coronavirus Response Act]] into law to provide economic relief to families affected by the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/mcconnell-urges-colleagues-support-coronavirus-economic-relief-bill/story?id=69664853 (ABC News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Salt Lake City earthquake]]
**An earthquake with a magnitude of 5.7 hits [[Salt Lake City]], [[Utah]], with several [[aftershock]]s reported and tens of thousands of residents left without power. The earthquake is the largest in the state since the [[1992 St. George earthquake]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/03/18/us/utah-earthquake/index.html (CNN)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on education]]
***More than 850 million students are not attending school due to the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]], according to [[UNESCO]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/world/2020/03/18/More-than-850-mln-students-worldwide-not-at-school-due-to-coronavirus-UNESCO.html (Al Arabiya)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in The Gambia]]
****[[The Gambia]] reports its first confirmed case of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], a female patient in her 20s who recently returned from the [[United Kingdom]]. The patient is in isolation at a clinic in [[Fajara]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/gambia-confirms-first-coronavirus-case/1769877 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Burkina Faso]]
****[[Burkina Faso]] reports its first death from COVID-19, a 62-year-old diabetic woman. [https://www.africanews.com/2020/03/18/burkina-faso-s-first-covid-19-death-claims-top-lawmaker// (Africanews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Djibouti]]
****[[Djibouti]] reports its first confirmed case of COVID-19, a member of [[Spain]]'s [[Special Operations Groups (Spain)|Special Operations Groups]] who arrived at [[Djibouti–Ambouli International Airport]] on March 14. [https://africa.cgtn.com/2020/03/18/djibouti-confirms-first-case-of-covid-19/ (CGTN Africa)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
***[[Iran]]'s [[Ministry of Health and Medical Education]] says the country's COVID-19 death toll stands at 1,135 following 147 more deaths. The total number of cases rises to 17,361. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-iran/irans-death-toll-from-coronavirus-jumps-to-1135-state-tv-idUSKBN2151LA (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****In [[Italy]], the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus]] death toll rises to 2,978. A total of 35,713 people have the virus in the country. [https://www.haaretz.com/world-news/europe/coronavirus-death-toll-in-italy-s-lombardy-jumps-319-in-one-day-1.8687844 (''Haaretz'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****All schools in [[Scotland]] and [[Wales]] are to close, effective March 19, in response to the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-all-schools-in-scotland-and-wales-set-to-close-on-friday-11959688 (Sky News)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-51928400 (BBC News)]
****The COVID-19 death toll in the [[United Kingdom]] surpasses 100. [https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/news/uk-news/uk-death-toll-coronavirus-17945196 (''Manchester Evening News'')]
****The [[United Kingdom]] advises its citizens vacationing in [[Spain]] to return home due to the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2020/03/18/world/europe/18reuters-health-coranvirus-britain-spain.html (''The New York Times'')]
****The [[British government departments|British government’s]] [[Department of Health and Social Care]] confirms an additional 676 cases of COVID-19 within 24 hours. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/uk-positive-coronavirus-cases-jump-by-676-in-24-hours/1770920 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]], [[2020 Spain coronavirus lockdown]]
****[[King of Spain|King]] [[Felipe VI]] of Spain addresses the nation in a special speech for the second time in his reign, and the sixth by a monarch in the democracy’s 40 years. Focusing on the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]], he gives his appreciation for the work of health personnel and calls for a break in differences, stating that Spaniards can "defeat this crisis" through unification. [https://english.elpais.com/politics/2020-03-19/spains-king-felipe-vi-we-are-going-to-defeat-this-crisis.html (''El País'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[President of Portugal|Portuguese President]] [[Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa]] declares a [[state of emergency]], the first in the country in 45 years, due to the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]]. [https://www.politico.eu/article/portugal-declares-state-of-emergency-coronavirus-covid19-antonio-costa/ (''Politico Europe''])
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***The [[United States]] and [[Canada]] suspend nonessential travel between the two countries due to the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/canada-us-border-deal-1.5501289 (CBC News)] [https://www.cnn.com/2020/03/17/politics/us-canada-suspend-travel/index.html (CNN)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****The [[United States]] reports its 150th death from COVID-19, with a total of at least 9,400 confirmed cases nationwide. [https://www.yenisafak.com/en/world/us-coronavirus-deaths-hit-150-cases-over-9400-3514388 (''Yeni Şafak'')]
****[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on education]]
*****In the [[United States]], several [[K–12]] school systems will keep their learning facilities physically closed for the remainder of the academic school year due to the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]], resulting in 92,000 American schools across 39 states, and 42.1 million students and their families, transitioning to [[educational technology|online learning]], while some systems will not calculate grades at all. [https://www.edweek.org/ew/section/multimedia/map-coronavirus-and-school-closures.html (''Education Week'')] [https://www.cnn.com/2020/03/18/us/coronavirus-schools-not-going-back-year/index.html (CNN)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
*****[[Michigan]] reports its first death from COVID-19, as the state reaches 110 recorded cases. [https://www.woodtv.com/health/coronavirus/hospital-reports-first-coronavirus-death-in-michigan/ (WOOD-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)|COVID-19 pandemic in New York]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Washington (state)|COVID-19 pandemic in Washington]]
*****COVID-19 cases in [[Washington (state)|Washington]] exceed 1,000. [https://www.foxnews.com/health/coronavirus-cases-top-1000-in-washington-state (Fox News)]
*****The [[United States Navy|U.S. Navy]] will deploy a [[hospital ship]] to [[New York City]] to aid in the response to COVID-19. [https://www.businessinsider.com/us-navy-deploying-floating-hospital-help-fight-coronavirus-new-york-2020-3 (''Business Insider'')]
***** A [[hospital ship]] will be deployed to the coast of [[Washington (state)|Washington state]] by the [[United States Navy|U.S. Navy]] to assist in the response to COVID-19. [https://www.npr.org/sections/health-shots/2020/03/18/817650302/coronavirus-kansas-becomes-1st-state-to-end-school-year-but-may-not-be-last (NPR)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
***[[Turkey]] reports its second death from COVID-19, a 61-year-old male patient, while the number of confirmed cases rises to 191. [https://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/coronavirus-death-toll-in-turkey-climbs-to-2-153089 (''Hürriyet Daily News'')]

;Law and crime
* The [[Abortion Legislation Bill 2019]] passes its third reading in the [[New Zealand House of Representatives]], legalising [[abortion in New Zealand]]. [https://www.stuff.co.nz/national/120389800/new-zealands-fourdecade-old-abortion-laws-have-changed-after-law-passes-final-reading (Stuff)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 United States elections]]
**[[2020 United States House of Representatives elections]]
***[[2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Illinois]]
****In a major upset in the [[2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Illinois|2020 U.S. House of Representatives elections in Illinois]], [[Democratic Party (United States)| Democrat]] [[Marie Newman]] defeats conservative Democrat [[Dan Lipinski]] in [[Illinois's 3rd congressional district]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/03/18/us/politics/marie-newman-dan-lipinski-illinois.html (''The New York Times'')]
**[[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
***[[United States Senator|U.S. Senator]] [[Bernie Sanders]] says he will assess his [[Bernie Sanders 2020 presidential campaign|presidential campaign]] after losing three more states ([[2020 Florida Democratic primary|Florida]], [[2020 Illinois Democratic primary|Illinois]], and [[2020 Arizona Democratic primary|Arizona]]) to former [[Vice President of the United States|Vice President]] [[Joe Biden]] in the [[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries|Democratic primaries]] of the [[2020 United States presidential election|2020 presidential election]]. Biden has 1,181 delegates, while Sanders has 885. The minimum required to win the nomination is 1,991. [https://thehill.com/homenews/campaign/488181-sanders-will-assess-his-campaign-after-coronavirus-response (''The Hill'')] [https://www.cnn.com/2020/03/18/politics/bernie-sanders-assess-2020-campaign/index.html?utm_term=15845389123841fc1819a30d8&utm_source=Breaking+News&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=155001&bt_ee=lZQQ7mSDiOktuAOe2O6czwtuTtihjRJyxNgrupBwZMZ8ZstFEfK015Yc58ymeh09&bt_ts=1584538912396 (CNN)]
**[[2020 Republican Party presidential primaries]], [[Bill Weld 2020 presidential campaign]]
***Former [[Governor of Massachusetts|Massachusetts Governor]] [[Bill Weld]] ends his [[Bill Weld 2020 presidential campaign|presidential campaign]] for the [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] nomination in the [[2020 United States presidential election|2020 U.S. presidential election]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/03/18/us/politics/bill-weld-drops-out.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kosovo]]
***[[Prime Minister of Kosovo]] [[Albin Kurti]] sacks Interior Minister Agim Veliu over disagreements regarding a [[state of emergency]] in response to the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-kosovo/kosovo-pm-sacks-interior-minister-over-coronavirus-idUSKBN21527X (Reuters)]
**[[2020 United States Senate election in Alabama]]
***[[Alabama]] postpones its [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican Party]] Senate primary to July 14 due to [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus]] concerns. [https://thehill.com/homenews/campaign/488217-alabama-postpones-march-31-gop-senate-runoff (''The Hill'')]
**The [[White House]] postpones a state visit from [[Spain]]'s King [[Felipe VI]] and [[Queen Letizia of Spain|Queen Letizia]] due to the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]]. [https://www.seattletimes.com/nation-world/nation-politics/white-house-postpones-spain-state-visit-cites-coronavirus/ (''The Seattle Times'')]
**U.S. [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] [[United States House of Representatives|Representative]] [[Mario Díaz-Balart|Mario Diaz-Balart]] of [[Florida]] tests positive for [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/03/18/politics/mario-diaz-balart-coronavirus/index.html?utm_term=158457377680623c121a54fc0&utm_source=Breaking+News&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=155001&bt_ee=bS%2FOO68Rt8pN%2F%2BF4G7i07d9EGoxxv0EkU6F48DMsPjNydDA0oQOyJG5yky8kUdo7&bt_ts=1584573776813 (CNN)]

;Science and technology
*[[2020 in spaceflight]]
**[[SpaceX]] successfully launches and deploys 60 [[Starlink]] satellites on a [[Falcon 9]] rocket. The Falcon 9 rocket, making a record fifth launch, misses the [[autonomous spaceport drone ship]] ''Of Course I Still Love You'', crashing in the [[Atlantic Ocean]]. [https://www.space.com/spacex-launches-starlink-5-satellites-misses-rocket-landing.html (Space)]

;Sports
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports]]
**[[2020 AFL season]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***The 2020 [[Australian Football League]] season opener between [[Richmond Football Club]] and [[Carlton Football Club]] will go on as planned despite the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus outbreak]]. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/51948907 (BBC News)]
*[[2020 NFL season]]
**[[New England Patriots]] [[quarterback]] [[Tom Brady]] leaves the team after 20 seasons and, pending contract stipulations, will sign with the [[Tampa Bay Buccaneers]]. [https://usports.org/tom-brady-to-sign-with-tampa-bay-buccaneers-pending-contract-stipulations (uSports)]
